title: Polish & Stability Update
headline: Login flow fixed for new users, dashboard loads faster on every return visit, and History now tracks every action.
changes: Fixed: Login screen no longer flashes over the welcome animation when signing in for the first time via Google or Discord.
Fixed: Dashboard no longer re-polls hardware on every visit — specs are cached for the session so returning to Dashboard is instant.
Fixed: All optimization actions (NIC Tuning, Startup Apps, Debloater, Security, and more) now appear correctly in History.
Improved: App window fades in slightly faster on launch (600ms).
Improved: Power Plan page is cleaner — System Intent section removed.
